description:
“I can do good work… so can't you please… let me live here?” 

A girl, whom Taesin once helped during his days as a detective, suddenly came looking for him… with an excuse to repay the favour she owed. Desperate, she cried and clung to him, insisting that she would do all the housework. In an attempt to scare her away, Taesin had responded coldly: 

“I don’t need a woman to do my housework. There’s only one thing I need from her.” 

“And that is?” 

“A woman who will surrender her body to me. Do you still want to stay after knowing that fact?” 

He thought she’d received his message, but her response was completely different from what he had expected. 

“I…I can do it. I’ll do whatever you say, Detective!” 

“Song Yeonhee, if you're truly that desperate to stay here, then how about you strip off your clothes right here and right now?” 

And that's how Taesin ended up with the ‘perfect’ housewife.
